nodes.description: Private uint256 secret number (1-16) used as the winning guess; written by shuffle().
Public timestamp of the last play() call; read by kill() for its time gate.
Public minimum bet of 0.2 ether enforced in play().
Public owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor; used as access-control check in kill().
Public array of Game structs recording every player and guess.
Constructor: sets ownerAddr to msg.sender and calls shuffle().
Internal function deriving secretNumber from sha3(now, blockhash) modulo 16 plus 1 (weak randomness).
Payable game entry: records the guess, pays out the whole balance on a win, then reshuffles and stores the timestamp.
Owner-only selfdestruct guarded by msg.sender and a 6-hour time condition.
Anonymous payable fallback that accepts plain ether transfers.
Caller-controlled address used for owner assignment, player recording, payout and kill authorization.
now/block.timestamp, miner-influenceable, used for randomness and the kill() time gate.
msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) external value transfer executed before state finalization; reentrancy surface.
suicide(msg.sender) destroys the contract and forwards the balance; privileged destructive operation.
sha3(now, block.blockhash(block.number-1)) % 16 + 1 predictability: timestamp/blockhash dependence makes the secret guessable.
Player-supplied guess (uint256) passed to play(), required to be <= 16.
Local Game struct instance populated with msg.sender and the guess, then pushed to gamesPlayed.
lastPlayed + 6 hours unchecked uint256 addition in kill(); overflow can wrap in Solidity 0.4.23.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the caller-controlled msg.sender to ownerAddr.
Constructor calls shuffle() to initialize secretNumber.
shuffle() consumes the miner-influenceable now value.
shuffle() derives its randomness from sha3(now, blockhash) and performs the modulo.
Weak randomness operation depends on block.timestamp.
shuffle() writes the computed value into secretNumber.
Predictable randomness result controls the winning secret number.
play() reads msg.sender to record the player.
Caller-supplied guess parameter is consumed by play().
play() pushes the local Game into gamesPlayed storage.
play() reads secretNumber to compare against the guess.
play() performs an external value transfer to msg.sender before finishing its state updates.
transfer() invokes the recipient, enabling re-entry into play() before lastPlayed/shuffle finalization.
play() calls shuffle() after each attempt.
play() updates lastPlayed with the current timestamp.
play() stores now (block.timestamp) in lastPlayed.
play() reads betPrice for the require() bet check.
kill() reads msg.sender for its authorization check.
kill() compares msg.sender against the stored ownerAddr.
kill() reads lastPlayed for the time gate.
kill() gate depends on block.timestamp (now > lastPlayed + 6 hours).
kill() performs unchecked lastPlayed + 6 hours addition.
kill() reaches the privileged suicide(msg.sender) selfdestruct.
The kill beneficiary and authorizer is the caller-controlled msg.sender.
Constructor reads msg.sender for ownership initialization.

normalization_plan.reason: The callable parameter number has no independent identity; it is an input of play(), so fold it into the play() function node.
Local Game struct instance game exists only inside play() and is discarded after gamesPlayed.push, so it merges into play().
